purpose: Preserve working product-output and evidence pipelines as executable contracts before company overhaul changes working paths.

spec_validators.scope: umbrella manifest, page-output executable spec, crossmatch spec, A3 phrase/abbrev matrix, required invariants, dirty buckets, and authority boundaries

manifest_rows.target_output: Canonical reader/book page shell with stable corpus/work metadata and source passage preHUD wiring.
invariants: normal book header and compact corpus/work metadata
visible and clickable source passage area present
one Hebrew token per preHUD row
source token text is visible and copyable
source token click/keyboard jump maps to matching preHUD row
preHUD text remains TBD unless selected/display_eligible route exists
one preHUD row per underlying token in changed rows
no old escaped HUD markers
no stale tok-* leakage text in rendered row content
no LTR Hebrew rendering regression in source layout
no accepted text/definition authority implied
page scope is not accepted as definition output
expected_outputs: proof_report with page list and validator result
manifest_rows.blocker_shape: book_page_contract_blocker | target_page | missing_marker_or_invariant | command | timeout | next_owner | stop_condition
manifest_rows.owner_slot: A10 product implementation standard; A14 target/output topology; A4 changed-output validation
manifest_rows.model_floor: A5/weaker model can run only after target pages and validators are explicit.
manifest_rows.next_owner: A4 for validation, A10 for package truth, A5 for repeatable runs when packet is complete
manifest_rows.gate: No activation; A7/owner final gate required for runtime/product adoption.
manifest_rows.stop_condition: Pass scoped page contract validator or return exact missing invariant.

manifest_rows.target_output: Route HUD popout with selected/default route, alternatives, match reason, confidence or match percent, source/license evidence, crossmatch evidence, and body scroll lock.
manifest_rows.input_manifest: page_output_pipeline_v1.page/HUD invariants plus route lookup and lexical token data
invariants: HUD opens from source token or preHUD affordance only
body scroll lock while HUD is open
selected/default route is distinct from alternatives
selected route displays only when route-backed and display-safe
HUD source/license area always inspectable
crossmatches shown as evidence-only navigation rows
preHUD and HUD percent/match basis remains consistent
no lemma-only/morphology/form-reference/usage-only text promoted into preHUD unless gate clears
no old escaped HUD markers or `data-hud-*` non-whitelisted attributes
no stale token-id (`tok-*`) leaks into visible HUD text
no accepted gloss/Definition authority claim
manifest_rows.blocker_shape: route_hud_contract_blocker | page | missing_hud_field | source_license_visibility | display_gate_status | validator | next_owner | stop_condition
manifest_rows.owner_slot: A10 owns HUD protocol and package truth; A14 owns topology/prototype expectations; A4 validates changed runtime/page outputs
manifest_rows.model_floor: A5/weaker model can run validator but cannot infer missing HUD fields.
manifest_rows.next_owner: A10 for package truth if HUD behavior drifts; A4 for validation
manifest_rows.gate: A7/owner gate for activation; A6 only for boundary-sensitive evidence dockets.
manifest_rows.stop_condition: Route HUD contract validates on golden fixtures or exact HUD drift blocker is returned.

manifest_rows.target_output: Visible book/HUD page output from inputs through render, including shell, source passage, preHUD rows, Route HUD, and evidence-only crossmatch behavior.

invariants: normal book header and compact corpus/work metadata
source passage rendered as clickable tokenized anchors
one preHUD row per rendered token
HUD opens from token/source affordance
scroll lock while HUD is open and return link works
selected/default route separated from alternatives and match-backed
source/license evidence area is present for displayed route-backed candidates
crossmatch rows are evidence/navigation only
quiet TBD on unresolved/unsafe routes
preHUD/HUD % match basis must remain consistent
no stale old-HUD markers in page/runtime
no stale `tok-*` visible leaks

manifest_rows.blocker_shape: page_output_pipeline_blocker | target_page | changed_inputs | failed_invariant | command | timeout | partial_output | next_owner | stop_condition
manifest_rows.owner_slot: A14 target/output shape; A10 implementation standard/package truth; A5 repeatable runner; A4 changed-output validator
